contract.meaning: Structural declaration of included graph/private-db/projection files bound to manifest payload hash, profile and selected workspace ownership; not authentication, public-safety attestation or execution/writer authority.
contract.privacy: Only already-included paths appear. No excluded private paths, excluded payload hashes, DB contents or operational records are added to public policy metadata.
contract.producer: Fresh exports emit and validate the declaration after shared state classification. Enabled registered child configurations are consulted even when their workspaces are unselected; their private payloads remain excluded unless selected. Undeclared or disabled ambiguous configuration custody refuses before payload reads.
contract.consumers: Both manifest validators, materialization, template import and projections validate the declaration and owning configurations when included. Child-only config validation uses policy roots bound to the global workspace index.
contract.historical: Policy-less public snapshots remain bounded inspection-only; their missing transport policy is not guessed. Clone/fork continue to require an actual owning root configuration.
contract.private_portability: Selected private child checkpoints remain byte-preserving positive controls; live runtime state, sidecars and checkout authority remain excluded.
contract.snapshot_binding: Bundle receipts hash the parsed ZIP bytes. Template apply verifies and uses one held source snapshot under its lock. Imported capability/body projections consume the validated bundle snapshot and bind projected metadata to its bundle hash/profile. Existing safe cached-body reads after genuine deletion remain supported.

failing_before_evidence: Seven contract cases failed before implementation: fresh public policy absent and six contradictory or malformed policies ignored.
Conventional nested state was read as payload; undeclared child configuration allowed custom live payload reads.
Changing bundle bytes after projection returned unverified body data; capability projection reopened a different bundle snapshot.
A verification receipt could hash bytes different from those parsed; template application could consume a changed source between preview and apply.

Candidate review hypotheses reproduced: an unselected child's custom live DB, checkpoint and receipts entered a public root-only export; a child-only private bundle accepted a consistently rehashed injected live DB in graph/private-db roles.

candidate_review.kind: single independent offline read-only candidate review
candidate_review.disposition: Both parent-reproduced hypotheses corrected at shared ownership/configuration boundaries and covered by negative regressions plus selected-private portability controls.

focused_post_review.scope: bundle_state, bundle, bundle_ownership, subgraph_containment, node_body and zip

full_pre_review.freshness: Historical intermediate run before the two final review corrections; not substituted for the post-review run.

validation.post_record_checks: pending; record a separate validation addendum after evidence and required projections are updated

remaining_before_bug_closure: Complete bounded alternate-representation checks, distinguishing unconfirmed hypotheses from reproducible defects.

Bind implementation acceptance to final test-479/platform/Standard/task-828 obligations; source tests alone are not final release qualification.
custody: Sole Goal86 writer continues owned Bug17 progress; all earlier planning and Bug35/40 edits preserved. No active runtime DB lease, queue message or transient mutation lock; five historical leases remain released.
temporary_evidence: Owned full-test receipts/logs and synthetic review reproductions retained under the dedicated temporary transport run; no raw security report or operational payload copied into the repository.
